ui.privacyBody:
CLENIX collects your name, phone, address, property details and preferences to review your cleaning inquiry and contact you. On submission, these details are transmitted through the Telegram Bot API to the CLENIX team’s chat. Telegram processes data under its own terms.
This site does not store customer details in a database; delivered messages may remain in the operator’s Telegram chat. The hosting provider may retain technical access logs. When optional abuse protection is enabled, request identifiers and a hash of your IP address are processed temporarily. Contact and address fields are not written to browser storage.
No advertising tracking is used. An essential language preference cookie may be used. Contact CLENIX at +90 501 528 44 82 about correcting or deleting your details. Please avoid sensitive information in notes.
ui.termsBody:
This form sends a cleaning inquiry. It does not confirm an appointment, create a payment obligation or establish a final quote. Your preferred date and time depend on availability and require CLENIX confirmation.
Area estimates are the square meters multiplied by the published starting rate. AC cleaning is added at the stated per-unit rate. The final scope and price are agreed with you after reviewing the address, dirt level, furnishing and property type. Other special requests are not included in the calculation.
Please provide accurate contact and address details. To change or withdraw your inquiry, call +90 501 528 44 82. Payment, cancellation and other service arrangements are discussed directly when needed; this site does not establish those commitments.
